newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gucci Q3 net revenues $230.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Gucci Q3 net revenues $230.2 mln.

text.p: Luxury goods maker Gucci Group said on Thursday its third quarter net revenues were up 69.1 percent to $230.2 million from $136.1 million in the third quarter fiscal 1995.
Year-to-date, total net revenues reached $620.2 million, an 81.2 percent increase over the same period of fiscal 1995.

During the third quarter, sales through Directly Operated Stores increased 64.9 percent, while Wholesale sales (franchise, duty free, and speciality store distribution) were up 110.8 percent compared to the third quarter of the last year.
